release_notes: HikMicro HM-TD2H67H1-25 is an industrial thermographic heat-resistant network bullet camera with a 640x512 uncooled VOx thermal detector (17 um, NETD <= 35 mK), 25 mm F1.5 athermalized lens (narrower 24.8 x 19.9 FOV), 50 fps and object temperature measurement from 0 to 1800 C. Its air-/liquid-cooling SUS304 housing lets it operate in ambient temperatures up to 200 C for molten metal, kiln, glass and billet-conveyor monitoring.
